items.title: JSW Steel’s Q1 profit soars 2x YoY on robust topline growth
items.description: JSW Steel's profit more than doubled year-on-year to 4,696 crore in the June quarter. Robust revenue growth and higher volumes aided the company's strong financial performance. Consolidated revenue from operations rose around ten percent on year to 47,364 crore. Total expenses grew less than four percent on year, which helped profitability. The company's net debt also saw a significant reduction during the period.

items.title: Reliance Retail's Q1 profit drops 14% YoY but revenue rises 8%
items.description: Reliance Retail Ventures reported a fourteen percent profit decline last quarter. Revenue from operations grew eight point two percent year-on-year. Investments in e-commerce and digital infrastructure pressured operating margins. The company aims to double operating Ebitda over three years. Reliance Retail expanded its store network to over twenty thousand locations.

items.title: RIL's Q1 operational revenue hits milestone with 25% YoY jump
items.description: Reliance Industries saw a twenty-five percent profit drop in the June quarter.  Revenue from operations increased twenty-five percent, crossing three lakh crore rupees.  Reliance Retail's net profit declined fourteen percent while revenue grew eight percent.  The oil-to-chemicals segment revenue rose over thirty percent amid market volatility.  Jio Platforms reported its first profit decline due to 5G asset capitalization.

items.title: Axis Bank Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 23% YoY to Rs 7,114 crore; NII up 8%
items.description: Axis Bank Q1 Results: Axis Bank reported a 22.5% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 standalone net profit to Rs 7,114 crore, while net interest income increased over 8% to Rs 14,646 crore, beating estimates. Asset quality remained stable, with the lender reporting strong balance sheet growth, robust deposit mobilisation and healthy loan expansion.

items.title: Yes Bank Q1 Results: Net profit surges 34% YoY to Rs 1,071 crore; NII advances 18%
items.description: Yes Bank Q1 Results:  Yes Bank reported a 34% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 standalone net profit to Rs 1,071 crore, while net interest income grew 17.5%. Asset quality improved year-on-year but saw a sequential uptick in NPAs. The bank said stronger core earnings and steady margins reflect improving business fundamentals.

items.title: PNB Q1 Results: Net profit surges 214% YoY to Rs 5,253 crore; NII up 2%
items.description: PNB Q1 Results: Sequentially,  however, net profit rose marginally by a little over 0.5% QoQ from Rs 5,225 crore reported in the preceding three months.

items.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q1 Results: Net profit climbs 26% YoY to Rs 4,123 crore; NII rises 9%
items.description: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q1 Results:  Kotak Mahindra Bank reported a 26% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 standalone net profit to Rs 4,123 crore, while NII increased 9%. Asset quality improved year-on-year, with gross and net NPAs declining, though margins moderated during the quarter. The bank’s deposits and advances continued to grow.

items.title: IDBI Bank Q1 Results: Net profit grows 5% YoY to Rs 2,115 crore, NII climbs 10%
items.description: IDBI Bank reported a 5% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 standalone net profit to Rs 2,115 crore, while net interest income grew over 10%. Deposits and advances posted healthy growth, asset quality improved year-on-year despite a marginal sequential uptick in NPAs, and capital adequacy remained robust.

items.title: ICICI Bank Q1 Results: Profit jumps 16% YoY to Rs 14,805 crore; NII rises 13% as margins expand
items.description: ICICI Bank Q1 Results:  ICICI Bank posted a 15.9% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 standalone net profit to Rs 14,805 crore, while net interest income grew 12.7%. Asset quality improved, advances and deposits registered healthy growth, and provisions declined, supported by strong core operating performance and robust fee income during the quarter.

items.title: HDFC Bank Q1 Results: Net profit rises 5% YoY to Rs 19,060 crore, NII up 7%
items.description: HDFC Bank Q1 Results: HDFC Bank reported a 5% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 standalone net profit to Rs 19,060 crore, while net interest income increased 7%. Profit beat Nomura’s estimate but missed Kotak’s forecast. Asset quality remained stable, provisions declined sharply year-on-year, and the bank maintained a strong capital adequacy ratio.
